scope: Original 125 source floor plates, 1,205 floors and four people per room are preserved and observed through inherited physics checks. New facility bodies, engine shapes, Korean Label3D glyph bounds and complete declared entry/walk segments are independently observed. Representative portals use physical E and facility walking uses production Input actions after explicit scenario starts. Native rendering is required for actual MultiMesh/material readback and screenshots; hash-linked headless evidence covers the full catalog. These are authored game facilities, not surveyed hotel/building layouts, access permissions, usable food/showers/baths/gym equipment, or a long-running performance test.
